𝗟𝗜𝗩𝗘 𝗜𝗡 𝗗𝗢𝗛𝗔! 🏏

Bangladesh A 33/2 after 11 overs in the Rising Stars semi-final. Ali Raza removed Saif Hassan (14) and Joy.

Can Pakistan A keep the squeeze on? 👇
#RisingStars #Cricket

👉 Bangladesh A ne toss jeet kar batting chuni, 11 over baad 33/2
👉 Ali Raza ne Saif Hassan (14) aur Joy ko jaldi nipta diya
👉 Jeetne wala final mein Sri Lanka A se bhidega

Kya Pakistan A ye pakad aage bhi banaye rakhegi?

#CricketKiBaat #RisingStars #Cricket
